name: customer
description: Minimal governed dictionary for a canonical customer record.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.definition: Stable enterprise identifier for one customer; never reused.

fields.name: legal_name
fields.definition: Current legal name recorded by the customer master.

fields.name: status
fields.definition: Current lifecycle status of the customer relationship.

fields.name: credit_limit
fields.definition: Current approved credit limit in Australian dollars; null when no credit facility exists.
